measurement_method: Lighthouse Mobile preset on the live URL, cache off, 3000-word essay, 5 runs, take second-slowest LCP

requirement: Essay save request completes in 1500 ms or less on all five attempts
measurement_method: DevTools Network Duration on the save POST, same 20000-character body, 5 runs, all must pass

requirement: 99% or better HTTP 200 on landing page, index and one essay URL, with no outage over 30 minutes
measurement_method: checks at least three times daily for the four weeks before Week 14, deploy outages excluded and logged in hours-log.csv

requirement: Restore a working site with every published essay in 4 hours or less from an empty database
measurement_method: timed drill on the development database following the runbook without improvising, Week 13

requirement: Zero admin routes serve content or accept a POST without a valid session
measurement_method: Playwright test looping the route list with GET and POST, run in CI on every push

requirement: Zero occurrences of the passphrase, session secret or connection string in git history or the client bundle
measurement_method: git log pattern search over full history, Select-String over .next/static, gitleaks in CI

requirement: Zero of twelve attack payloads execute, inject, or raise a dialog when rendered as a comment
measurement_method: submit and approve each payload then assert no dialog, no new script element, literal text; run in CI

requirement: Zero axe-core violations rated serious or critical on the landing page, index and an essay page
measurement_method: Lighthouse Accessibility plus axe DevTools at 1440 px and 390 px, sidebar open and collapsed

requirement: All eight keyboard-script steps completable with focus always visible and no keyboard trap
measurement_method: manual walkthrough in Chrome and Firefox with the mouse unplugged, focus ring screenshotted at each step

requirement: Four of five first-time visitors reach an essay within 60 seconds with no help
measurement_method: five moderated sessions on participants' own devices, one-line task, stopwatch, observer silent

requirement: All eight catalogued error messages name the problem and the fix
measurement_method: trigger each of the eight conditions, score cause and remedy, rewrite and retrigger failures

requirement: A newcomer reaches a running local app in 30 minutes or less using only the README
measurement_method: timed clean-machine run with no help given, undocumented steps added and run repeated; Weeks 13 and 15

requirement: Zero failing steps in Chrome, Firefox and Edge on Windows 11 and Safari on iOS, no sideways scroll at 390 px
